name: conversational-insights-devkit
description: Google Cloud Conversational Insights (CCAI Insights) MCP tools, skills, and guarded config promotion.

settings.name: GCP Project ID
settings.description: Default Google Cloud project ID for Conversational Insights (CCAI Insights).

settings.name: Insights Location
settings.description: Regional endpoint location (e.g., us-central1, europe-west1, global).

settings.name: Allowed GCP Projects
settings.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of GCP project IDs permitted for tool calls.

settings.name: Allow Guarded Writes
settings.description: Set to 'true' to enable confirmation-gated export, import, ingestion, and bulk analysis tools.
